$comment: languages-world-2 (11 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for MONGOLIAN, Cyrillic (mn-MN): харшил / харшл (харшилтай, харшлын), аллерги, үл тэвчих, мэдрэг, целиак, анафилакси, the -гүй free-from forms (глютенгүй, сүүгүй, өндөггүй, самаргүй, загасгүй, лактозгүй…), агуулаагүй / агуулахгүй, агуулж болзошгүй, ул мөр, аюулгүй, идэж болохгүй / чадахгүй, бохирдол — stems survive the suffixes (самаргүй юу). Common Latin-keyboard spellings (harshil, glutengui, suugui, samargui, ayulgui) are added. ө and ү are kept by the normaliser. Bare гүй is NOT a stem (inside магадгүй; сонгиногүй is a preference), nor тохиромжтой (= convenient). OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
